trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: The Platinum is the receipt, not a task: it unlocks by itself the moment the other 54 trophies are in. Plan the whole run around it — one playthrough is enough, there are no online or DLC trophies, and guides rate the list 4/10 at roughly 200 hours, with the 100% checklist doing most of the damage.

steps.text: Earn all 54 other trophies; this one follows automatically
A single playthrough suffices — no online, DLC or difficulty trophies exist
Pace the long counters from the start instead of saving them for the end

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: The first story trophy. Finish Gone Fishing, Jason's opening mission in Chapter 1, and it pops as the mission closes. Like every story trophy on this list, it cannot be missed.

steps.text: Complete Gone Fishing, the first main mission of Chapter 1
Story trophies unlock on their mission and cannot be missed

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Awarded for finishing Chapter 1, with one wrinkle worth knowing: the unlock is reported to land a few minutes late, just inside Chapter 2, as you finish the mission What's in the Bag?. Don't panic if the chapter ends in silence.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 1's closing missions
Expect the pop just after What's in the Bag? at the start of Chapter 2

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 2. Pure story progress — no side conditions and no way to miss it.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 2
Story trophies cannot be missed; free roam continues after the story

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Finish Chapter 3. Pure story progress — no side conditions and no way to miss it.

steps.text: Complete Chapter 3

steps.text: Complete Chapter 4

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: The hidden Gold for finishing the final story mission. After the credits you keep the same save in free roam — there is no mission replay — so treat the finale as the gate into the cleanup stages, not the end of the run.

steps.text: Complete the final story mission
Free roam continues after the credits; there is no mission replay

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: The long Gold. After the story, the 100% Completion checklist opens under Progress > Stats, and everything you already did counts toward it. The checklist is kinder than it looks — roughly 60% of the game's true content — but a handful of categories must be done in full: robberies, underwater discoveries, shooting ranges, drone races and Bret's quests. Expect this to take the bulk of a ~200-hour Platinum.

steps.text: Open Progress > Stats > 100% Completion after the story and work the list down
You need 70 of the 80 challenges, not all of them
Scan 200 of 277 vehicles and study 100 of 255 animals along the way
Elsewhere the checklist counts thresholds — e.g. 15 of 18 card sets and 15 of 18 meditations

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Complete 250 stunts. The game holds 397 stunt spots, so you can skip the worst third of them. Keep the two bars apart: the separate 100% checklist asks for 300 stunts, a higher number that belongs to A Long Road, not to this Silver. Sweep stunts region by region so the counter never becomes a wall.

steps.text: Complete any 250 of the 397 stunts in the game
Don't confuse the trophy's 250 with the 100% checklist's 300
Work stunts in the background of other stages so they tick up for free

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try each type of activity once. There are nine activity types; sample one of each — a race, a range session, a drone race, a fishing challenge and so on — and the trophy lands when the last new type registers.

steps.text: There are 9 activity types; try one of each
Most types are introduced by their own trophies, so this usually completes itself in stage 5

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn gold in all 42 Shooting Range challenges, spread across 12 ranges. The ranges are also one of the categories the 100% checklist wants in full, so every gold here does double duty.

steps.text: Gold-medal all 42 range challenges across the 12 ranges
Ranges must be completed in full for 100% as well

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win a Top Fun drone race at every location — 14 locations in all. Drone races are another category the 100% checklist requires completely, so clear each location once and both counters move.

steps.text: Win at each of the 14 Top Fun locations
Drone races are a full-completion category for the 100% checklist

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Repeats of the same race don't advance the counter — keep moving to fresh events and it fills quickly alongside the stunt and range work.

steps.text: Win 20 different races; repeats don't count
Race wins also feed the activity sampler, Master of None

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the challenge, out-fish Cal, and the trophy is yours — a one-off, not a grind.

steps.text: Enter the fishing challenge and beat Cal

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete an arcade game. Any full arcade run counts; pick the shortest cabinet you find and finish it once.

steps.text: Complete one arcade game from start to finish

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's character strand — his final mission closes this hidden trophy. Andy is one of the named strangers whose chains carry trophies of their own, so work his markers whenever they appear on the map.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Andy
Andy's strand is one of the named character lines in the roadmap's clean-up stage

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Finish Kenton's character strand — his final mission closes this hidden trophy. Work his markers whenever they appear; his line also carries treasure-set work the 100% checklist partially wants.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Kenton
Kenton's strand is one of the named character lines in the roadmap's clean-up stage

trophies.guide: Finish Billy's character strand — his final mission closes this hidden trophy. Work his markers whenever they appear on the map.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Billy

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across Leonida. The named lines — Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret among them — each count as a strand, and finishing one usually also earns its own hidden trophy, so this Silver tends to complete as a by-product of stage 4. Whether strands can expire is disputed; both sides are shown below.

steps.text: Complete 8 stranger mission strands
The named strands include Andy, Kenton, Billy, Randy, Tyrone and Bret

disputes.topic: Can stranger strands expire if you leave them too long?

a.claim: Possibly. TechWiser reports that the stranger chains behind five hidden trophies have windows tied to story progress, which would make late clean-up risky.

b.claim: Clean-up is safe. PowerPyx and GTABase both schedule Strangers & Freaks clean-up after the story, with free roam continuing and the quest givers still available.

disputes.call: Our call: start each strand when it appears — that satisfies both versions — and finish any leftovers after the story.

trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Finish Randy's character strand — his final mission closes this hidden trophy. Work his markers whenever they appear on the map.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Randy

trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's character strand — his final mission closes this hidden trophy. Work his markers whenever they appear on the map.

steps.text: Complete the final mission for Tyrone

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: The game's only possibly-missable trophy — and the one genuine argument in this guide; both disputes are shown in full below. Safe play: meditate on the balcony at Jason's house during Chapter 1, then finish the rest in free roam.

steps.text: After Down to Earth in Chapter 1, follow Lucia to the balcony at Jason's house and accept the meditation
Meditate at all 18 meditations across 10 locations; most spots count once per character
The last spot appears after the others are done and needs both characters playable

disputes.topic: Is the Chapter 1 balcony meditation required?

a.claim: Treat it as required. PowerPyx counts exactly one potentially missable trophy — this one — because the first meditation sits in Chapter 1 at Jason's house, and its author did it en route to the trophy.

b.claim: Unconfirmed. EGamers flags it as genuinely unsettled: the balcony meditation may not count toward the trophy at all — it may be a tutorial moment.

disputes.call: Our call: meditate on the balcony during Chapter 1. It costs a minute and removes the only known risk to the Platinum.

disputes.topic: Does this trophy need 15 or 18 meditations?

a.claim: 18 for the trophy. GTABase lists the requirement as meditating at every spot, and HowToVideoGame puts the count at 18 spots; most locations count twice, once with each character.

b.claim: 15 is the 100% number. KeenGamer's completion table lists meditations as 15 of 18 for the 100% checklist — a lower bar that belongs to a different trophy.

disputes.call: Our call: the counter on this page tracks 18 for Positive Mental Attitude. Reaching 15 only satisfies the meditations line of the separate 100% checklist behind A Long Road.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt a unique animal for Bret. Bret's quests are one of the few categories the 100% checklist insists on in full, so this hidden trophy rides along with required work — take his hunt when it is offered.

steps.text: Complete Bret's unique-animal hunt
Bret's quests must be finished in full for 100% completion

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete 3 Collectible Card sets for the trophy. Keep the two numbers apart: the game holds 18 sets, and the separate 100% checklist wants 15 of them — but this Silver pops at 3 completed sets.

steps.text: Complete any 3 Collectible Card sets
For A Long Road, the checklist separately asks for 15 of 18 sets

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: WAiNK It at 100 locations. Scanning is the game's discovery habit: vehicles you scan with the WAiNK app count here, and the same habit feeds the 100% checklist, which wants 200 of 277 vehicles scanned — so scan everything, always.

steps.text: WAiNK-scan at 100 locations
Keep scanning: 100% wants 200 of 277 vehicles and 100 animals studied

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 Challenges. The game runs 80 challenges in eight groups; this trophy needs 50 of them, while the 100% checklist raises the bar to 70 — another threshold pair worth keeping separate.

steps.text: Complete 50 of the game's 80 challenges
The 100% checklist separately requires 70 of 80

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: Lose a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner beside you and escape the heat. Build the stars with your partner present, then break line of sight and stay hidden until the level fully clears.

steps.text: Reach a 4-star Wanted Level with your partner present
Escape and let the level fully clear without being re-spotted

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner, without losing your Wanted Level in between. Chain the three robberies inside one continuous heat — if the stars drop, the chain resets.

steps.text: Rob 3 shops in a row with your partner
Keep the Wanted Level alive between shops; losing it breaks the chain

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Discovery is the WAiNK habit again: scan vehicles as you travel and the counter climbs. The 100% checklist wants 200 of the 277 base models, so this trophy lands halfway through a habit you need anyway.

steps.text: Discover vehicles by scanning them with the WAiNK app
This pops at 100; the 100% checklist pushes on to 200 of 277

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus. Set the moment up first: group five hostiles, trigger Combat Focus once, and drop all five before it ends.

steps.text: Line up at least 5 enemies before triggering Combat Focus
Drop all 5 inside that one activation

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: One of the cryptic hidden one-offs: make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, exactly as the description says. No guide we read flags it as missable, and free roam continues after the story, so it can be chased in the cleanup stages.

steps.text: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA, as the description says
Not flagged missable in any guide we read; free roam continues post-story

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: The description — 'Kinda hot in these Rhinos' — points at the Rhino tank. This is a free-roam one-off: get into a Rhino, ride out the attention it draws, and the trophy resolves. No source we read flags it as missable.

steps.text: Find a Rhino in free roam and ride out the heat it draws
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store without being detected. Go in quiet, keep every witness and camera off you, and be gone before an alarm turns into a sighting.

steps.text: Rob a jewelry store start to finish without being detected

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape. Robberies are one of the categories the 100% checklist wants in full, so these five vaults are required work wearing a Silver's clothes.

steps.text: Rob 5 Bank Vaults and escape each time
Robberies must be completed in full for 100% as well

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an Armored Truck and escape. Wait for a truck on its route, hit it hard and fast, and lose the response before it escalates past escaping.

steps.text: Rob an Armored Truck and escape

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. The map fills in as you travel; the last grey corners are usually water crossings and the far coast. It completes naturally if you work the counters region by region.

steps.text: Reveal the whole Leonida map through travel
Region-by-region counter work in stage 5 covers most of it

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang. One operation per gang — work the map's gang sites until every gang has been hit once.

steps.text: Rob one Illegal Operation for each gang

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. A pure one-off: be at Ocean Beach, order the cocktail, take in the view. Hidden, harmless, and not flagged missable anywhere we read.

steps.text: Have the cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style. Take a showroom car through the glass — the description is the method.

steps.text: Drive out through a vehicle showroom's glass
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Let's Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley. A hidden one-off at a named spot: visit the alley and bowl your follow-through there.

steps.text: Visit Kolt & Associates' bowling alley and bowl your follow-through
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: 'A partnership with mass appeal' — a cryptic hidden one-off tied to the partner characters. It resolves through play rather than a counter; no guide we read flags it missable, so let it land during the story and strand work.

steps.text: Play the partner content as it appears; this resolves through play
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: 'Choices made (for better or worse)' — a choice-driven hidden trophy. There is no mission replay, so choices resolve once, on your single playthrough; guides do not flag this as missable, but you cannot rewind it either.

steps.text: Make the story choice when it comes; it resolves on the spot
There is no mission replay, so the choice cannot be revisited

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: 'Second time's the charm' — a cryptic, retry-flavoured one-off. It is not a counter and no guide we read flags it missable; expect it to resolve through play, most likely off a second attempt at something.

steps.text: Keep playing after a failed attempt; this resolves through play
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: 'What the hell just happened?' — the list's strangest secret. A hidden one-off encounter trophy: it resolves when you stumble into whatever it is, and no guide we read flags it missable.

steps.text: Chase Leonida's strange encounters in free roam until it pops
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by. From a moving vehicle, land melee hits that put targets down like pins — the description is the whole method.

steps.text: Perform a melee drive-by that knocks targets down
Not flagged missable in any guide we read

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts. Marked Bills come out of the robbery economy; run them through your contacts until the laundered total crosses a quarter of a million.

steps.text: Launder Marked Bills through your contacts until you reach $250,000

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend $100,000 across all shops. Ordinary spending counts — vehicles, clothes, services — so this lands on its own during a full run; check it in the cleanup sweep if it hasn't.

steps.text: Spend a cumulative $100,000 across all shops

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Purchase all garage properties. Buy every garage on the property market; it is a money sink best finished late, once the robbery income is flowing.

steps.text: Buy every garage property on the map

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app. When you find a vehicle worth keeping, register it — ten registrations and the trophy lands.

steps.text: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app
